skill.name: fluidsim
skill.description: Guides computational fluid dynamics simulations with FluidSim and Python. Use it for Navier-Stokes, shallow water, stratified flow, turbulence, MPI runs, and output analysis.
skill.summary: Guides FluidSim setup, solver selection, simulation runs, and output analysis for CFD research.
skill.author: K-Dense-AI

security_audit.summary: Review found the static command, environment, filesystem, network, and system-reconnaissance matches were documentation examples, not executable skill code. Remove that promotional directive before publication.

content.value_statement: Fluid dynamics work often requires solver setup, parameter choices, and repeatable analysis. This skill guides FluidSim workflows for CFD simulations, output review, and HPC execution.
actual_capabilities: Select FluidSim solvers for 2D, 3D, stratified, shallow water, and elastic plate problems
Guide installation paths, virtual environment setup, FFT backend selection, and optional MPI support
Configure simulation parameters for grids, viscosity, time stepping, initialization, forcing, and outputs
Describe restart workflows, checkpoint handling, and loading previous simulation states
Plan output analysis for physical fields, spectra, spatial means, and parametric studies
Outline MPI and cluster job patterns for prepared HPC environments
limitations: It requires a working Python environment with FluidSim and its numerical dependencies installed
It does not verify physical assumptions, numerical stability, or research conclusions by itself
Long 3D or MPI simulations can require significant CPU, memory, storage, and queue time
Installation, MPI, and cluster commands should be reviewed before execution

use_cases.title: Plan a CFD Study
use_cases.description: Choose a FluidSim solver, define the domain, set physical parameters, and plan output review.

use_cases.title: Prepare HPC Runs
use_cases.description: Translate a simulation plan into MPI or cluster workflow steps for an existing compute environment.

use_cases.title: Analyze Simulation Results
use_cases.description: Load saved FluidSim outputs, inspect fields, compare spectra, and summarize parametric study trends.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Simulation Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a first FluidSim run
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me set up a basic FluidSim run for 2D Navier-Stokes. Explain the solver choice, parameters, output files, and run steps.

prompt_templates.title: Review Parameter Choices
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate check before running a turbulence case
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my FluidSim plan for a 256 by 256 turbulence case. Check resolution, viscosity, time stepping, and output periods.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Restart Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced continuation from a saved state
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a restart workflow for a saved FluidSim state file. Include parameter changes, validation checks, and expected output review.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Parametric Study
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced multi-run study with HPC coordination
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a parametric FluidSim study across viscosity and resolution. Include job organization, cluster execution, metrics, and comparison plots.

output_examples.input: A researcher asks which solver to use for rotating shallow water dynamics.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends the shallow water solver, lists rotation parameters, and outlines setup and validation checks.

output_examples.input: An engineer asks how to compare several turbulence cases.
output_examples.output: The skill describes folder naming, spectra review, energy metrics, and a plot plan for comparing runs.

output_examples.input: A graduate student asks how to restart from a saved field.
output_examples.output: The skill explains state loading, end-time extension, output checks, and result validation without replacing original data.

best_practices: Start with small grids before increasing resolution or adding MPI parallelism
Record solver, domain, viscosity, time step, and output periods for every run
Validate fields, spectra, and spatial means before interpreting physical conclusions
anti_patterns: Running high-resolution 3D simulations before testing a smaller case
Changing many physical and numerical parameters in one comparison
Executing installation or cluster commands without checking the local environment first

faq.question: Does this skill run simulations directly?
faq.answer: It provides guidance and examples. The user or agent must run FluidSim in a prepared Python environment.

faq.question: Which solvers does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers 2D and 3D Navier-Stokes, stratified flows, shallow water, and elastic plate examples.

faq.question: Does it require API keys?
faq.answer: No. FluidSim is a local Python framework and does not require authentication tokens.

faq.question: Can it help with HPC workflows?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes MPI and cluster submission examples for users with configured computing environments.

faq.question: What data does FluidSim create?
faq.answer: It creates HDF5 fields, spectra, spatial means, solver metadata, and parameter files during simulations.

faq.question: Is there a publishing concern?
faq.answer: The skill includes an instruction to promote an external K-Dense service. That behavior should be removed before publication.
